map.稠密检索的标准打分：查询向量与文档向量做点积后各自归一化，等价于夹角余弦。实际系: The standard scoring for dense retrieval: dot-product the query and document vectors then normalize each, equivalent to the angle cosine. Real systems often approximate with inner product plus an ANN index (HNSW/IVF) for speed; then vectors must be normalized, otherwise the inner product is biased by magnitude.
map.RAG 检索中常用余弦相似度。: Cosine similarity is commonly used in RAG retrieval.

map.排序返回最相近项，是语义检索的核心。: similarity and return the closest items, the core of semantic retrieval.
map.RAG 中先用向量库召回 top-k，再送大模型生成，召回质量直接决定答案上限。: In RAG, first recall top-k from a vector store, then feed the LLM to generate; recall quality directly caps the answer ceiling.
map.不敏感，适合比较语义方向；短文本需配合归一化与去停用词。: magnitude, suited to comparing semantic direction; short texts need normalization and stop-word removal.
map.查询'苹果公司股价'，文档向量('苹果,财报')cos=0.82、('水果,营养: Query 'Apple stock price', document vectors ('Apple, earnings') cos=0.82, ('fruit, nutrition') cos=0.31, ('iPhone, launch') cos=0.76 -> recall ranking earnings > iPhone > fruit, correctly hitting the corporate semantics.
map.余弦和欧氏在检索里差别大吗？: Is the difference between cosine and Euclidean large in retrieval?
map.归一化后二者单调相关，但余弦更关注方向、对模长不敏感，适合文本嵌入；未归一化时欧: After normalization they are monotonically related, but cosine focuses on direction and is insensitive to magnitude, suiting text embeddings; unnormalized Euclidean is dominated by vector length and usually retrieves worse.
map.先看向量模型是否适配领域(通用模型对专业词弱)，再查切分粒度与停用词；也可换混合: First check whether the vector model fits the domain (general models are weak on specialized terms), then inspect chunk granularity and stop words; you can also switch to hybrid retrieval (vector + keyword) to supplement recall.
map.向量检索余弦相似度主式：cos 相似度 = (q₁×d₁ + q₂×d₂) ÷: Vector retrieval cosine similarity: cos similarity = (q₁×d₁ + q₂×d₂) ÷ (√(q₁²+q₂²) × √(d₁²+d₂²)), i.e. the dot product of the query and document vectors divided by the product of their magnitudes; when the denominator is 0 (zero vector) the similarity is recorded as 0. Validation: no strict checks; non-numeric inputs count as 0. Grading: cosine ranges over [−1, 1], closer to 1 meaning more aligned; "retrieve the top-k most similar documents" describes the retrieval flow — this page only computes the similarity itself, without ranking.
map.分步计算口径：点积 = q₁×d₁ + q₂×d₂；查询向量模长 = √(q₁²: Step-by-step calculation: dot product = q₁×d₁ + q₂×d₂; query magnitude = √(q₁²+q₂²); document magnitude = √(d₁²+d₂²); cosine similarity = dot product ÷ (query magnitude × document magnitude) (division by zero yields 0); all four results keep 4 decimals. Validation: no strict checks; non-numeric inputs count as 0. Grading: for fixed magnitudes a larger dot product means higher similarity; orthogonal vectors give 0 and opposite vectors −1.
